[b]New Ancient Quality (Red Quality) Unlocked for Some Mercenaries[/b]
After combatting with the ancient bosses, those mercenaries with great wisdom learned to use the ancient power to enhance themselves. Thus their power has grown stronger so that they can better face the threat from the Devil’s realm.

As they are stronger now, they won’t want to work for every traveler, but only for those with greater power, so they can challenge stronger bosses and get more energy.
Travelers and their mercenaries can therefore learn and master the lost ancient energy, and imitate the ancient power, to become much more powerful than before. 

[b]These mercenaries will be upgraded to ancient quality after the update:[/b]
Arnaud, Brimstone, Ironheart, Dynor, Shari, and Draculis
[b]Their growth rates are increased:[/b]
- Ironheart: Life increased from 1.05 to 1.1, Crit increased from 0.85 to 0.9
- Draculis: Attack increased from 1.45 to 1.5
- Dynor: Attack increased from 1.3 to 1.4, Crit increased from 1.15 to 1.25
- Arnaud: Attack increased from 0.9 to 1
- Shari: Defense increased from 0.8 to 0.9
- Brimstone: Attack increased from 0.85 to 0.9, Life increased from 1.1 to 1.15, Roughness increased from 1.15 to 1.2

[b]Please note that ancient mercenaries will be hard to acquire. Here are the rules:[/b]
1. The total rate of getting ancient mercenaries from Taverna is 0.5%;
2. The total rate of getting regular 5-star mercenaries from Taverna is decreased from 5% to 4.5%;
3. Ancient mercenaries’ shards will be less likely to appear in Rogue Hero;
4. Ancient mercenaries’ shards will not be available in Lucky Cards;
5. From now on, players can purchase all the 4 and 5-star mercenary shards (except Norton’s) from the diamond shop if they own them already. 10 ancient mercenaries’ shards will cost 350 diamonds. The possibility for ancient mercenaries’ shards to show in the diamond shop is low.

[b]Other than those, these following will be updated in the new patch as well:[/b]
1. New Content
- New avatars available now for Infinity Edge and each artifact after that. Players can choose to equip them.

- Redone the visual display of Taverna while recruiting a mercenary.
- Redone the effects of rewind.
- To make it easier for players to track the tasks and collect rewards, guided tasks will be presented on the main interface following a certain order. Players can choose to close this function in settings.

- Arnaud's 1st skill - Torrent
Summons a Current to randomly send an enemy flying, dealing Dark Damage equal to 352% Attack Power.
adjusted to
Summons a Torrent in the frontal area, send all enemies in the area flying, dealing Water Damage equal to 352% Attack Power.

Increase base Dodge of robots summoned by Explosive Mech from 10 to 60

notes.title: Release postponed

Dear Players：
 
We are very sorry to say that we have postponed the release of Endless World which was originally on 15th August. During our internal test, we found issues that will affect the gameplay experience. Postponing the release was a very very difficult choice for us. But in the end, we wanted everyone to play a good game, instead of a bad one. We will use the time to fix the issues, and collect feedback from the community. We will do our best to launch the game as soon as possible. 
Thank you all for your support.

Endless World
